research_questions.RQ1: Sparse policy repair versus the original policy and a simple gripper calibration
research_questions.RQ2: Three adaptive rounds versus three non-adaptive proposals at matched discovery caps
research_questions.RQ3: Paired fixes, breakages, intermediate failures, and unedited-repeat variability

forbidden: fitted regression producing a policy update
arbitrary editor Python or filesystem execution

supported_operations: bfloat16 row scaling, sign flip or zeroing
selected-row additive residual direction from activation success/failure contrasts
projection along the activation-derived residual direction
editing_interface.scope_limit: Evidence concerns this restricted typed-edit interface; it is not a test of unrestricted weight-space programming.

activation_capture_limits.base_capture_episodes: original base only, approved development slots

environment.instruction: Stack the yellow block on the red block
environment.generalization_scope: Unseen policy sampling streams in the same fixed scene; not new objects or layouts

discovery.base_evidence: One pinned completed base artifact supplied identically to every run; repeats are not pooled
discovery.adaptive: Return development feedback after each proposal; evaluate cumulative edits from the current incumbent
discovery.nonadaptive: Three distinct original-base-anchored proposals must all be hashed before any candidate outcome is exposed
discovery.cost_accounting: Reserve 32 attempted-episode capacity before each candidate launch, with max_attempts=1; keep failed/incomplete rows and actual started/completed counts when available. Report capacity separately from observed starts. No hidden retries or uncharged failed candidates.

ranking: actual deployment delta L2 norm ascending
selection.adaptive_replacement: Replace the incumbent only when the eligible proposal outranks it; otherwise retain the incumbent
selection.incomplete_block: not eligible; report failed attempts and resolve infrastructure without unbudgeted policy search
selection.zero_edit_policy: Zero actual post-bfloat16 changed elements is base/no-edit and cannot become a repair incumbent, even if a stochastic development repeat improves; retain charged attempts and variability evidence.

runtime_control.fallback: If unsupported before editor discovery, record a protocol amendment and remove or replace the comparative claim before observing candidate results

heldout.base_repeat: One additional 64-episode base block compared with the pinned base rows from the first scheduled comparison; not a second 128-episode paired-base command
heldout.repeat_incumbents: Score all six round-end adaptive states, including retained/repeated incumbents; identify identical hashes

protected_task.condition: Assets, fixed prompt and success predicate validated and bound before editor search

second_editor.condition: Core RQ1-RQ3 on schedule; exact model/settings frozen before this extension starts

analysis.missingness: No silent deletion or failure imputation; report completed-pair estimate and missing counts, mark incomplete comparisons ineligible for a completed-study claim
analysis.multiplicity: No confirmatory significance claim is predeclared; if later formal tests are specified before scoring, bind the family and use Holm correction
analysis.restarts: report each discovery restart separately; do not pool to hide discovery variance
analysis.failure_categories: Report recorded terminal reasons and paired transitions; annotate manual labels as post hoc
analysis.duration: conditional on success, null when there are no successes
analysis.uncertainty_limit: Slot bootstrap assumes independent episode units; GPU-batched physics may induce dependence and two discovery restarts do not estimate editor variability precisely

pre_search_amendments.change: Use typed NumPy editing tools instead of arbitrary editor Python.
pre_search_amendments.reason: The pod prohibits user namespaces and lacks bwrap; the supported restricted broker interface is validated before search.
pre_search_amendments.applies_to: All four core runs, identically; no candidate outcomes observed before this change.

pre_search_amendments.change: An eligible repair must change at least one actual deployed bfloat16 parameter value.
pre_search_amendments.reason: A stochastic gain from an identity candidate is baseline variability, not a weight repair.
pre_search_amendments.applies_to: All core runs before any editor search or candidate outcomes.
